newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound stable against dollar in private trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound stable against dollar in private trade.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was stable against the dollar on Monday but demand for the U.S. currency kept exchange rates relatively high in the private sector market, bankers said.
"The market is dollar liquid but not as much as to bring the rates lower. The pound is stable," a banker said.
Another said some foreign investors were selling their treasury bill holdings and buying back their dollar investments after yields on both 91-day and 182-day bills slipped.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3920 and 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3935 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3941 pounds bid and 3.3956 pounds offered. The averages compare to 3.3943 bid and 3.3961 offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.393081 buy and 3.396888 sell.
